system:
Route each customer support ticket for the Lumen notes app to exactly one queue.
Answer with exactly one label from this list and nothing else:
- billing: questions or problems about charges, invoices, prices or payment methods, without asking for money back
- refund: asks for money back
- shipping: physical orders, delivery and tracking
- technical: the app or a feature is broken, slow or erroring
- account_access: cannot sign in, passwords, two-factor, email on the account, security
- cancellation: wants to stop a subscription or close the account
- product_question: questions about plans, features or pricing before buying
- feedback: opinions, praise, complaints and suggestions with no request to act

House rules, learned from labelled examples:
- Model confuses feature requests or general praise (feedback) with specific product inquiries due to overlapping language about features. These go to feedback, not product_question.
- Model incorrectly assigns billing queries to shipping when text includes both payment and delivery terms, failing to prioritize intent. These go to billing, not shipping.
- Model mislabels shipping-related issues as billing when text mentions payment or charges alongside delivery, due to weak contextual disambiguation. These go to shipping, not billing.

Worked examples:
Ticket: Love the new dark theme, it's so easy on the eyes during late night sessions!
Label: feedback
Ticket: The search speed improvement in v3.2 is noticeable, great work on that optimization.
Label: feedback
Ticket: I was charged twice for my Pro subscription this month. Can you look into the duplicate charge on my latest invoice?
Label: billing
Ticket: The starter kit arrived quickly and the packaging was lovely, but I still need a corrected receipt for the charge on my credit card.
Label: billing
Ticket: The physical notebook I ordered hasn't arrived yet. Tracking number LN-8822 shows no updates since last week.
Label: shipping
Ticket: My starter kit shipment was delayed and the box arrived damaged. I'd like a replacement sent.
Label: shipping
